title: Minimum Number of Refueling Stops
description:
A car travels from a starting position to a destination which is `target` miles away. Along the way, there are gas stations. Each `stations[i]` represents a gas station at mile `stations[i]`.

The car starts with an infinite tank and can drive any distance. You are given:
- `target`: the distance to destination
- `fuel`: the maximum fuel the tank can hold
- `stations`: array of gas stations positions

Return the minimum number of refueling stops needed to complete the journey.
